title: On Entitling the essay after the old bridge
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：entitle　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 entitle 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the builder ① entitled the essay after the old bridge on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② entitles the essay after the old bridge before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ entitle the essay after the old bridge at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ entitled the essay after the old bridge before — a line in the plan for October 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Entitling the essay after the old bridge on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ entitle them to a share of the land before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Entitle them to a share of the land at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ entitles them to a share of the land on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ entitled the essay after the old bridge again when nobody else would.

⑩ To entitle the essay after the old bridge, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody entitles the essay after the old bridge before dawn again and somebody must entitle the essay after the old bridge on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 给…命名（一般过去式 entitled the essay after the old bridge：1991 年施工员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 给…命名（一般现在 entitles the essay after the old bridge：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 给…命名（不定式 to entitle the essay after the old bridge：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 给…命名（过去完成时 had entitled the essay after the old bridge：1985 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 给…命名（动名词 entitling the essay after the old bridge 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使有权（entitle them to a share of the land：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使有权使他们有权分得一份田地）
G. v. 使有权（entitle them to a share of the land：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 给…命名（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 entitles them to a share of the land，而母亲又一次 entitled the essay after the old bridge）

entitle 意为“给…命名”，自那以后施工员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 entitles。
entitle 意为“给…命名”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯给…命名以那座旧桥给文章命名”，此处为不定式 to entitle the essay after the old bridge。
entitle 意为“给…命名”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人给…命名过，故用过去完成时 had entitled。

entitle 意为“使有权”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使有权使他们有权分得一份田地（entitle them to a share of the land at once），以后再也不要提起。
entitle 意为“给…命名”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例使有权使他们有权分得一份田地，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 entitles。
entitle 意为“给…命名”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就给…命名以那座旧桥给文章命名，用一般过去式 entitled 叙述。
entitle 意为“给…命名”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要给…命名以那座旧桥给文章命名，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 entitle 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the builder entitled the essay after the old bridge on the same day, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder entitles the essay after the old bridge before dawn whenever the site asks.
Entitling the essay after the old bridge on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever entitle them to a share of the land before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site entitles them to a share of the land on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother entitled the essay after the old bridge again, and the site remembered that half.
